units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，觉得这封信写得比往日的更加优美，令人不忍释手。

en.t: Prince Genji read it and felt that this letter was even more graceful than her usual ones, so lovely that he could hardly bear to put it down.

units.source_text: 既而又想：她自己害死了人，佯装不知，写信来吊慰，其实可恨！

en.t: Then he thought again: she herself had caused someone to die, yet she pretended not to know and wrote to offer condolences; it was truly hateful.

units.source_text: 但倘就此和她决绝，不通音问，似觉又太残忍。

en.t: But if he broke with her completely over this and stopped all communication, that too seemed far too cruel.

units.source_text: 这样对待她，岂不糟蹋了她的名誉？

en.t: If he treated her in that way, would he not be ruining her reputation?
In his heart he hesitated, unable to decide.

units.source_text: 终于想道：“死者已矣，无非前世宿命制定。

en.t: At last he thought, "The dead are gone; it was nothing other than a fate fixed by karma from a former life.

units.source_text: 但我何必清清楚楚地看到那生魂作祟的情状呢？”

en.t: But why did I have to see so clearly the sight of that living spirit working its curse?"

units.source_text: 后悔之余，不由得回心转意，对六条妃子的爱情终于不忍断绝。

en.t: Amid his regret, he could not help changing his mind, and in the end he could not bring himself to sever his love for the Rokujo lady.

units.source_text: 他想写回信，但念此时妃子正陪伴斋宫清心洁身，不宜阅读丧家来信，多时犹豫不决。

en.t: He wanted to write a reply, but remembering that the lady was then attending the Ise priestess in ritual purification, he thought it improper for her to read a letter from a house in mourning, and he hesitated for a long while.

units.source_text: 继而又想：她专诚来信，我置之不理，未免太过无情。

en.t: Then he thought again: since she had taken the trouble to write, it would be much too heartless of me to ignore her.

units.source_text: 便在一张紫灰色的信笺上写道：“久疏问候，但思慕之心，无时或怠。

en.t: So on a sheet of purplish gray letter paper he wrote, "It has been long since I last sent my greetings, yet my longing for you has never for a moment grown slack.

units.source_text: 只因身在丧服之中，未便致信，此情想蒙谅鉴。

en.t: Only because I am still in mourning has it been improper for me to write; I trust you will understand this feeling.
